coverage.WORLDS: Implemented; 126 rooms × 3 qualities tested; seven representative controlled room renders
coverage.ENEMIES: Eight canonical roles and actual regional aliases; five active native simulation before/after captures
coverage.ATMOSPHERE: Bounded quality-dependent cosmetic movement, wall inlays and fog; reduced motion preserves warnings
coverage.LESSON: Optional Living hub primer; actual buttons switch profiles, campaign run unchanged
coverage.COMPAT: 60 protected files, existing engines/saves/controller/wrist/boss regressions, six browser suites and offline Pages

details: A low Verdant growth entered the body envelope and crossed a native south gate. Moved it onto the wall and excluded all native gate axes.
Yaw calculation treated a valid zero locked direction component as a fallback value. Corrected exact cardinal directions.
The identity test initially omitted Oracle from the canonical danger-based fallback pool; retained actual Oracle support and documented that source.
corrections.resolution: 12 targeted tests now pass, including triangle bounds and preserved showcases

corrections.finding: Initial forward view still looked too empty
corrections.resolution: Added family-specific long-wall relief and recaptured the actual renderer

corrections.finding: First enemy capture harness turned instantly and could trip tracking safety
corrections.resolution: Discarded those captures; gradual valid synthetic turns now assert unpaused gameplay and valid input. Both cohorts recaptured.

corrections.finding: Ephemeral Chromium was absent; normal Playwright download returned a truncated archive; package tar ownership extraction failed in this container
corrections.resolution: Installed development-only Chromium 153 package outside repository and unpacked without ownership changes. No app dependencies changed.

limitations: No physical Quest 3 retest; directed Spellcraft, headset comfort/legibility, sustained GPU and thermal behavior unverified.
Room selections are controlled fixtures. Enemies subsequently spawn and act through the actual engine; no natural seven-world campaign or story-gate traversal claim from these images.
No QA fixture launcher or practice enemy is included in the shipped game; the primer grants no rewards.
Crystal/reflection appearances use stylized layered geometry, not alpha refraction or real-time reflections.
Before/after CPU submissions are noisy and exclude GPU completion. More ordinary-room geometry costs more work; no Quest FPS or general speed improvement claim.
The five established bespoke stages are preserved; other rooms inherit world families, not individual handcrafted redesigns.
